boundary: Viewer.animate plus every frozen native dat.gui.updateDisplays rAF body

source.attribution: Amazon Lumberyard Bistro, distributed through NVIDIA ORCA; glTF/KTX2 conversion by qian-o. Original source FBX v5.2. See both preserved upstream notices.
source.scope: Unmodified BistroExterior glTF with all referenced KTX2 images and all 13 authored wind clips. The optional external HDRI is not a glTF dependency and is not selected.

purpose: Repeated diagnostic attribution for unchanged authored Bistro in the native Viewer, preserving shipped grid-off, DPR1 and first-clip autoplay. Original r176 packaging/migration and same-version r186 candidate comparisons are separate capture groups. No primary CPU quantile or FPS claim.

discovery.result: Native/observer and required same-version fixed gates, phase/pass, strict loader errors, original ZIP bytes, AC and source integrity passed. Smoke is not performance evidence.
discovery.analysis: Raw capture completed, but independent analyzer stopped on JS timeDeltas[4036] = -1 microsecond. Pure has 17,175 samples, JS 16,598 and Wasm 16,554. No sample was clamped, dropped or reordered. GUI/source/oracle discovery remains usable; smoke is not performance evidence.

limitations: Uncalibrated sampling/passive observer overhead; no primary callback CPU quantiles
Native first-clip wall-clock phase is not frame-matched across runs
No GPU timer or CPU/GPU-bound classification from scene size alone
Source asset visual fidelity warnings remain; fixed route equality is a narrower contract
Prior failed HTTP loads and Editor Blob failures remain separate unsupported input/app records
Twelve-second sampled weights and wider endpoint counter intervals have different denominators
This profile-only protocol cannot authorize primary timing

profileValidity.timeDeltas: Every sampled interval must be finite and nonnegative, as required by the existing analyzer. A violating profile remains invalid with its original bytes; no clamping, sample filtering, timestamp sorting or replacement run to obtain a pass.
profileValidity.incompleteCase: Report invalid or missing profiles and valid observations separately. An incomplete repeated case cannot qualify a candidate improvement.
profileValidity.sampleWeights: Elapsed-gap sampling is not a primary CPU quantile or CPU cycle count.
